description: This file defines the Room database for the note organizer app, including entities, DAOs, and a factory method for database creation.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class that extends RoomDatabase, representing the app's local database with DAOs for notes and synchronization states.

methods.name: create
methods.description: A static method to instantiate the database using the application context, configured with destructive migration fallback.
